brain.lede: {name} needs a brain to think. Pick one: you can change it any time.
brain.offline: You’re offline. A brain needs the internet to set up, unless one already runs on your computer.
brain.quick.title: Start in one click
brain.quick.text: Sign in with OpenRouter: a free account that gives access to hundreds of brains, some of them free.
brain.key.title: Use a key you already have
brain.key.text: Your key stays on your own devices, encrypted.
brain.key.open: Open {service}, and sign in or create an account
brain.key.create: Make a new key there, and copy it
brain.key.vertexOn: Open Vertex AI in Google Cloud, and turn it on for your project
brain.key.account: Open Service accounts, and make one with the role roles/aiplatform.user
brain.key.accountKey: Under its Keys, add a key in JSON: a file downloads
brain.key.accountFile: Choose that file below. It works until you delete the key.
brain.local.title: On your computer
brain.local.text: Use a brain that runs on your own machine, with Ollama or LM Studio.
brain.local.hint: In Ollama, allow this site with OLLAMA_ORIGINS={origin}. In LM Studio, turn on CORS.
brain.claude.title: Use your Claude plan
brain.claude.text: Answers with your Claude Pro or Max plan, through Claude Code, Anthropic’s program that comes with it: Connect installs it on this computer and signs you in to Claude if needed. It goes through “{computer}”, which Connect starts if it isn’t running.
brain.claude.install: Claude Code, Anthropic’s program that comes with your plan, isn’t on this computer yet.
brain.claude.installFailed: Claude Code couldn’t be installed. Check that this computer is online, then connect again.
brain.claude.signIn: Sign in to Claude in the browser window that opened, with the account that has your plan. Closed it? Connect opens another.
brain.claude.signInFailed: The sign-in to Claude didn’t finish. Connect again to start it over.
brain.claude.restart: “{computer}” is still running an earlier version. Stop it (Ctrl+C in its terminal, or quit the app) and start it again, then connect again.
brain.plan.start: “{computer}” isn’t running yet. Once it runs, the connection finishes by itself.
brain.copilot.title: Use your Copilot plan
brain.copilot.text: Answers with your GitHub Copilot plan, through Copilot CLI, GitHub’s program for using it in other apps: Connect installs it on this computer and signs you in to GitHub if needed. It goes through “{computer}”, which Connect starts if it isn’t running.
brain.copilot.install: Copilot CLI, GitHub’s program for using your plan in other apps, isn’t on this computer yet.
brain.copilot.installFailed: Copilot CLI couldn’t be installed. Check that this computer is online, then connect again.
brain.copilot.signIn: Sign in to GitHub in the browser window that opened, with the account that has your Copilot plan. Closed it? Connect opens another.
brain.copilot.signInFailed: The sign-in to GitHub didn’t finish. Connect again to start it over.
brain.gemini.title: Use your Gemini plan
brain.gemini.text: Answers with your Google AI Pro or Ultra plan, through Antigravity CLI, Google’s program for using it in other apps: Connect installs it on this computer and signs you in with Google if needed. It goes through “{computer}”, which Connect starts if it isn’t running.
brain.gemini.install: Antigravity CLI, Google’s program for using your plan in other apps, isn’t on this computer yet.
brain.gemini.installFailed: Antigravity CLI couldn’t be installed. Check that this computer is online, then connect again.
brain.gemini.signIn: Sign in with Google in the browser window that opened, with the account that has your plan. Closed it? Connect opens another.
brain.gemini.signInFailed: The sign-in with Google didn’t finish. Connect again to start it over.
brain.chatgpt.title: Use your ChatGPT plan
brain.chatgpt.text: Answers with your ChatGPT Plus or Pro plan: you sign in to ChatGPT and allow its use here, and ChatGPT’s settings show how much is used. It goes through “{computer}”, which keeps the sign-in on this computer and starts first if it isn’t running.
brain.chatgpt.declined: ChatGPT didn’t allow the use of your plan. To allow it, continue with ChatGPT again.
brain.chatgpt.failed: Signing in to ChatGPT didn’t work. Try again.
brain.device.text: Private and free, and it works offline: nothing you write leaves this computer.
brain.device.progress: {done} of {total}. You can keep using this page.
brain.sameText: One brain, at one version, for every message
brain.onlyText: Nothing you write leaves this computer
brain.gemini.billed: Billing is on for this key’s Google Cloud project, or you use it from the European Economic Area, the UK or Switzerland
brain.gemini.billedHint: Google then never trains AI on what this brain reads, so it may read what Gmail and Google’s other services bring in.
brain.versionHint: Auto uses Fast, Smart or Best, as each message needs. When you choose {brain} yourself, it answers with:
auto.both: {brain}, as much as each message needs, and this device for anything personal
auto.cloud: {brain}, as much as each message needs
auto.mix.lessText: The quickest brain for every message, a step up only when an answer falls short
auto.mix.balancedText: A quick brain for quick questions, a stronger one as the work asks
auto.mix.bestText: The strongest brain past a quick question, thinking thoroughly
auto.steps: Within a task, Auto steps up when an answer falls short, and never steps back down. A new task starts again from the bottom.
